birthday_person_facts: Jacob is turning 22 today — born March 10, 2004 in Saint Petersburg, Florida
He's a Computer Science major at University of Florida — Go Gators!
He calls himself a Software Engineer, Digital Innovator, and Web Designer on his portfolio site
He's a cross-platform web and app designer with a passion for making impactful technology
He co-created Sweat Smart — a workout planner app that uses ChatGPT to personalize routines, built with Flutter and Firebase
He built a financial analytics platform called Profiteer — a MERN stack app that visualizes spending and savings goals using D3 charts
He built an earthquake-preparedness survival game called Normal Weather in Godot with C# — choice-driven gameplay with state machines and physics
He also created ImHungry — a recipe discovery app with 10,000+ recipes and ingredient-based suggestions for healthy home cooking
He's been in Florida his whole life — a true sunshine state boy
He made the Honor Society for his academic achievements — brains AND brawn!
His buddy built this Mario AI bathroom bot just for his birthday party — that's friendship!
